messages.subject: How to create an app wiith multi Users and an administrator?
parts:
HI Experts!

I just started using Shiny to develop an application for a course, it should allow us to simulate the electricity market, and one of the important aspect is that each student who represents an actor (user) on the market should take decisions only on what happen during the previous iteration and therefore they should not be aware of what the others are doing. In that game, the teacher is the operator (admin), and take decision on what happen at a time t (it's an iterative process).

My first problem in developing that application is to set up a different environment in function of who is connect on the page using a login and a password. My first idea was to create a table on the server with the login and the password and which can detect if it is a user or an admin (basically I will have 3 columns ID, psswd and Admin/User). This table could be loaded by the app and check if the input data match these information. On top of that I could use the conditionnalPanel function to adapt the layout according to Admin/User. 

But I got doubts :

- first well I am not a programmer so I think experts have a much more elegant  way to do it

- second I am not sure I will be able to handle the users data in a close-to-real-time manner

FYI:
I am using the shiny server pro on a debian distribution

br.

Guillaume Le Ray
